startup.name: Northstar Bio
startup.tagline: Programmable protein therapeutics designed for solid-tumor oncology.

readiness.rubricNote: 3 of 20 stage checklist items are marked complete in the illustrative workspace sample. This is not an investment readiness score.

stages.label: Idea
stages.shortSummary: Validate problem urgency, customer segment and founding team alignment.

exitCriteria.label: Write and document the problem statement and hypotheses
exitCriteria.description: Write the core customer problem and the assumptions that still need validation.

exitCriteria.label: Log at least 10 customer interviews and synthesize insights
exitCriteria.description: Record at least ten discovery conversations and summarize recurring insights.

exitCriteria.label: Define the target customer profile
exitCriteria.description: Describe the target customer, their context and the job they need done.

exitCriteria.label: Estimate TAM, SAM and SOM with sources
exitCriteria.description: Estimate TAM, SAM and SOM, and attach a source for each key assumption.

exitCriteria.label: Get mentor confirmation that the problem is validated
exitCriteria.description: Ask the assigned mentor to confirm that the problem is validated.

stages.label: Prototype
stages.shortSummary: Ship core MVP workflow and run structured usability testing with design partners.

exitCriteria.label: Define and prioritize MVP scope
exitCriteria.description: Prioritize the smallest useful feature set for the MVP and document trade-offs.

exitCriteria.label: Release a working prototype to test users
exitCriteria.description: Share a working prototype with real test users and record the release.

exitCriteria.label: Get feedback from at least five test users
exitCriteria.description: Collect feedback from at least five test users; protect consent and private notes.

exitCriteria.label: Review feedback and plan the next iterations
exitCriteria.description: Review findings, prioritize the next iteration and assign follow-up actions.

exitCriteria.label: Get mentor confirmation that the MVP is functional
exitCriteria.description: Ask the assigned mentor to confirm the MVP is functional for testing.

stages.label: Early Revenue
stages.shortSummary: Convert pilot accounts into repeatable paid contracts and track unit economics.

exitCriteria.label: Onboard paying customers against a mentor-confirmed target
exitCriteria.description: Set a customer target with your mentor and record paying customers onboarded.

exitCriteria.label: Record recurring revenue for three consecutive months
exitCriteria.description: Record recurring revenue for three consecutive months with source notes.

exitCriteria.label: Document a repeatable sales process
exitCriteria.description: Document the repeatable steps from first contact through conversion.

exitCriteria.label: Calculate unit economics, including CAC and payback
exitCriteria.description: Record CAC and payback assumptions, inputs and calculation method.

exitCriteria.label: Get mentor confirmation of early traction
exitCriteria.description: Ask the assigned mentor to review the evidence for early traction.

stages.label: Mature
stages.shortSummary: Scale operations, governance and investor-ready diligence rooms.

exitCriteria.label: Prepare audited or reviewed financials
exitCriteria.description: Keep audited or independently reviewed financial statements accessible.

exitCriteria.label: Keep the cap table current
exitCriteria.description: Review ownership, share classes and option-pool records for accuracy.

exitCriteria.label: Establish a board reporting cadence
exitCriteria.description: Maintain a recurring board or governance reporting schedule.

exitCriteria.label: Complete the diligence data room
exitCriteria.description: Organize diligence documents and identify missing materials.

exitCriteria.label: Prepare a hiring plan for the next 12 months
exitCriteria.description: Document the roles, timing and budget planned for the next 12 months.

tasks.title: Synthesize findings from oncology lab director interviews
tasks.description: Consolidate interview notes, tag recurring needs and prepare a short synthesis for the mentor.

tasks.title: Conduct 6 remaining customer discovery interviews
tasks.description: Complete the remaining conversations with translational oncology teams.

tasks.title: Complete problem validation assumptions matrix
tasks.description: Document the core assumptions, what evidence supports them, and the next experiment.

tasks.title: Draft founding systems biologist hiring brief
tasks.description: Draft a role brief for the next specialist hire.

tasks.title: Define target customer ICP & clinical buyer personas
tasks.description: Capture the initial buyer profile and clinical stakeholder map.

tasks.title: Upload incorporation certificate & founder vesting schedule
tasks.description: File incorporation and founder equity records in the diligence room.

recentActivity.target: Define target customer ICP & clinical buyer personas
